HI-SU-03 is fixed in both the current and legacy sign-in strings: the transitive compound no longer needs an ergative ने and reads 'आपका Radient साइन-इन अब काम नहीं कर रहा।' The legacy twin was changed too.

HI-SU-01 is a regression, not a fix. The round-1 finding said the lone Latin Canvas was glossary drift; the key's English context sidecar explicitly says Canvas stays untranslated, and all six other locales keep it Latin. This is a self-correction: the applied value must be reverted to 'Canvas में खोलें' — see the finding for the exact expected string.

The broader locale already transliterates Canvas in other catalogue namespaces (ui.canvas, ui.command_palette, ui.mesh, shells). Those are outside this receipt's scope; if the product decides the Hindi rendering should be कैनवस everywhere, that requires an explicit design/product decision and a change to the source context plus the style guide, not a silent one-key divergence.
